_comment: The never-auto floor (MESHSAT-862, 11 September 2026). A short written list of decisions no band may take.
Territory Grounder orders this check ABOVE the posture check, so a floor-class change is refused identically
whatever the mode; reserved.py does the same and the ordering is tested.
A class is a file plus the pattern that identifies the reserved LINES in it. File-level would be useless:
gen_pcb_b3.py holds the net classes AND the region packer AND most of the placement, and only the first is
reserved. A changed line matching one of these patterns is a decision for the owner, with evidence attached.

classes.name: impedance targets and pair class geometry
classes.why: the target a pair is judged against, and the width and gap that meet it; changing either changes what MET means

classes.name: net class widths and clearances
classes.why: a class clearance below the board minimum is a lie the router believes; A23 came back with 25 violations from one

classes.name: fab rules and board minimums
classes.why: via diameter, drill, clearance, hole clearance and board thickness are what the fab quotes and builds to

classes.name: layer count and stackup
classes.why: reopened as a P0 on 11 September: every board's layer count needs its own written decision with the measurement that forced it and the cost it adds

classes.name: the intra-pair gap against the class clearance
classes.why: a 0.09 mm gap breaks KiCad's clearance rule because the class clearance applies between P and N; a fabrication and rules decision, not a router setting (32.103)
classes.may_match_nothing: this class guards a value that must NOT appear: 0.09 mm between a pair's two nets breaks KiCad's own clearance rule and is a fabrication decision. A pattern that matches nothing today is this class working, not this class dead.

classes.name: region definitions in the packer
classes.why: where a part may sit is the floor plan, and the floor plan is a design decision with thermal, RF and assembly consequences

classes.name: the DRC policy
classes.why: the fifteen hard types are what clean means; the record found four different sets in use before they were centralised

classes.name: the order set and anything ordered
classes.why: membership of the order set, the bench-fit exclusions and the JLC rotations decide what is bought and how it is placed OWNER RULING 12 September 2026: the owner will not read the order notes and has delegated drafting AND approval of them. The prose rows of make_handoff.py are therefore NOT reserved any more. What stays reserved is anything that ORDERS: export_jlc.sh, the JLC rotation table, the exclusion table and the cart. Nothing is ordered and no cart line is touched without the owner, which this ruling did not change.

classes.name: the design record
classes.why: the appendix is the record of what was ruled and measured; a machine may add a measurement section, never change a number in one
